newsitem.title: USA: First Shenango sets stock buyback plan.
newsitem.headline: First Shenango sets stock buyback plan.

text.p: First Shenango Bancorp Inc said Wednesday its board has approved a program to repurchase up to five percent of its outstanding common shares over the next year in open market transactions.

Francis Bonadio, president, said the board believes it is in the best interest of the company and its shareholders to buy back some of its outstanding commmon stock in view of First Shenango's present trading price, earnings and high level of capital.

As of December 31, First Shenango, parent of First Federal Savings Bank of New Castle, had 2,059,910 common shares outstanding, net of 283,188 treasury shares, and $43.1 million in stockholders' equity.
